profile.headline: Seasoned Android Engineer, Innovator, and Leader
profile.summary: Eric is a product-oriented Android engineer that takes great pleasure in both implementing beautiful designs and in creating product and feature concepts from the data and designs he is given.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Mentored junior developers and improved team adherence to architecture, creating performance gains and more readable code.
* Frequent collaboration with Staff Product Designer to improve old designs and create new ones.
* Focused on product creation and app performance for Spaces and API performance for Home Timeline
* Developing and experimenting for Spaces on Android.

positions.title: Principal Android Developer
positions.description:
* Led the team dedicated to launching the Xfinity Stream Beta on Fire TV.
* Led development in launching Xfinity Stream on NuEyes project.
* Led internal team dedicated to experimental Android expansions, including ownership of agile processes within team.
* Ran sprint retrospectives for the Android platform team and advocated for process changes to help support the Android team.
* Supported existing Xfinity Stream on Android phones and tablets.

positions.title: Android Domain Lead (Sr. Android Developer)
positions.description:
Android domain lead for Xfinity Mobile's mobile apps. Focused on:
 
1) Creating a maintainable, sustainable architecture for our account management app and visual voicemail apps. 
2) Designing the app to be highly flexible, enabling updates without new releases.

Pushing to improve the user experience and design as a developer, and guiding the automations team in building automated testing tools.

positions.title: Senior Android Engineer
positions.description: Developing for the XFINITY Android application suite. Lead developer of the XFINITY AnyPlay application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed for the Android XFINITY TV application suite. Major releases include Xfinity TV 1.0, Xfinity TV 1.2 to support tablets, Xfinity TV 1.4 to support Ice Cream Sandwich devices and AnyPlay, and Xfinity TV Player 1.0 for playback of OnDemand video.

Designed initial prototype, evangelized for, and will lead Android development of Xfinity Sports Remote application.

Previous roles include maintenance of Comcast's CMS responsible for ingesting and publishing articles, development of the ingest tools that provide Comcast's live and non-live sports data for publishing, development to ingest and process large batches of entertainment data, and development of APIs to make these various data pieces available internally.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught CIS105: Introduction to Programming for summer session.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Researched and developed a new AI decision algorithm.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Updated proprietary software and analyzed performance of software in order to determine viability for continued use.

projects.title: XFINITY AnyPlay
projects.description: With the XFINITY TV AnyPlay app, you can watch live TV on your Android Tablet or Phone anywhere around your home. AnyPlay® streams all your TV channels over your home Wi-Fi network so you can turn your mobile device into another TV screen. So whether you’re cooking, working, exercising or just hanging on the deck, you never have to miss a moment of your favorite show or the big game.

projects.title: XFINITY TV Player
projects.description: Download the XFINITY™ TV Player and put a world of entertainment in the palm of your hand. Watch your favorite XFINITY On Demand TV™ shows and movies on your Android phone or tablet – wherever you go.

patents.title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR VERIFYING APPLICATIONS
